baselineBehavior: Original cards example demonstrated flex column card layout with footer alignment, but lacked an automated verified walkthrough.
changedBehavior: Documented and executed a verified interactive walkthrough: initial footer alignment, unaligned state upon flex-grow removal, and complete restoration via reset.

walkthroughSteps.name: initial_layout_observation
walkthroughSteps.description: Card 1 and Card 2 footers align at the bottom because .content has flex: 1 1 auto.

walkthroughSteps.name: interactive_flex_removal
walkthroughSteps.description: When flex is 0, card 1 footer follows the short text immediately and is no longer pushed to bottom.

walkthroughSteps.name: reset_recovery
walkthroughSteps.description: Clicking Reset restores original CSS and footers re-align at the bottom.
